biomarkers.name: IDH1 R132 / IDH2 R172 mutations
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defines the entity in WHO CNS5 classification. Better prognosis than IDH-wildtype diffuse astrocytic gliomas/glioblastoma. Vorasidenib approved based on the INDIGO trial for residual or recurrent grade 2 IDH-mutant glioma after surgery

biomarkers.name: ATRX loss
biomarkers.prevalence: Very common in IDH-mutant astrocytoma (approximately 70–90%); helps distinguish from oligodendroglioma
biomarkers.clinical_use: ATRX loss + IDH-mutant + 1p/19q intact supports astrocytoma

biomarkers.name: CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion
biomarkers.clinical_use: In an IDH-mutant astrocytoma, homozygous CDKN2A/B deletion is a CNS WHO grade 4 criterion regardless of histologic features

biomarkers.name: MGMT promoter methylation
biomarkers.clinical_use: Associated with greater sensitivity to alkylating chemotherapy, although predictive utility is best established in glioblastoma

biomarkers.name: 1p/19q codeletion status
biomarkers.prevalence: Absent by definition in astrocytoma, IDH-mutant
biomarkers.clinical_use: Required to distinguish astrocytoma, IDH-mutant (1p/19q-intact) from oligodendroglioma, IDH-mutant and 1p/19q-codeleted

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Diffuse infiltrating glioma with astrocytic morphology (GFAP+, fibrillary or gemistocytic cells)
histomorphological_subtype.grading: WHO grade 2, 3, or 4; homozygous CDKN2A/B deletion is sufficient for grade 4 even without microvascular proliferation or necrosis

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: 'Cold' — infiltrated by tumour-associated microglia and macrophages rather than T cells; the blood-brain barrier limits immune access
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: No true stroma; tumour cells infiltrate along white matter tracts, blood vessels, and subpial regions (secondary structures of Scherer)

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Neural stem/progenitor cells or oligodendrocyte precursor-like cells (OPC-like states are supported by glioma modeling and single-cell studies)
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Neuroectoderm — CNS-restricted lineage (astrocytes derived from radial glia during development)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Astrocytic differentiation (GFAP+, often OLIG2+); IDH-mutant tumours retain features of neural stem/progenitor cells with distinct methylation programme (G-CIMP hypermethylation)
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Mutant IDH1/2 generates D-2-hydroxyglutarate (2-HG) — a competitive inhibitor of α-ketoglutarate-dependent dioxygenases including TET and histone demethylases — driving global hypermethylation (G-CIMP) and altered differentiation programs that distinguish these tumours from IDH-wildtype gliomas
